name: Extended Collectibles Tracker (iotrip fix)
description:
Where the remaining stuff at?

Version 1.0.12

A fork of FranklyGD's Extended Collectibles Tracker with the freezes and stale markers fixed. It installs under its own mod id, so it sits alongside the original rather than replacing it - enable only one.

The original: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3244633122

FEATURES - one Remix toggle each

- Show Map Markers: every collectible's exact spot on the map, in its own colour.
- Show Room Glow: a glow over a room holding one, before you have explored it.
- Show Room Names: each room's name above its shape.
- Show Collection Tracker: the sleep screen's grid in the map's top right, a column per region.
- Instant Map: the map opens and closes with the button, no delay or fade.
- Reveal Whole Rooms: a room appears complete when you enter it, not just where you walked.

Always on: a dot per pearl per region on the sleep screen, and the region's progress on the fast travel screen.

WHAT THE SYMBOLS MEAN

- Map marker: empty and pulsing while something is left to do with it, solid once it is not.
- Tracker dot: empty until collected or deciphered, filled after.
- Ring around a dot: that pearl is on you - held, swallowed, or in the shelter.
- Everything is drawn in its own collectible's colour.

FIXES OVER THE ORIGINAL

- The hibernation and death screens freezing, with the slugcat animation still playing - two separate causes.
- The picture freezing while the map is held, the game still running behind it, so Slug Senses and Key Item Tracking can both stay on.
- A pearl collecting a duplicate marker a few times a second, until the pile froze the map.
- Markers for pearls that have no type, pointing at pearls that are not there.
- Markers sitting where a pearl used to be, or a room away from where it is.
- A swallowed pearl's marker staying where you ate it until the next hibernation.
- A pearl carried in from another region, or swallowed, having no marker on the map at all.
- Pearl and token markers going stale until the next hibernation.
- A pearl in your hands as you slept not counting as being in the shelter with you.
- Instant Map revealing itself gradually the first time it opened in a region.

You are welcome to report bugs to me.
